releases.title: Clearer rewards at the end of a match
fixed: At the end of a match the reward messages (💎 crystals, ⭐ hero XP, 🎁 presents) now show one under another, so you can read every one
The emote buttons (👋 😂 🔥 GG) in a room match no longer cover the sound and full-screen buttons, or your cards on a phone
The WHAT'S NEW and REPORT A BUG windows close by themselves when a match starts

releases.title: Report a bug
new: 🐞 REPORT A BUG: logged-in players can tell the game team about a bug, something that doesn't work, an idea, or a player who cheats. Find it in the ACCOUNT menu (☰ on phones) and in the ? window
See your own reports and when the game team has seen or fixed them — sometimes with a note from us

releases.title: Smaller PLAY button + fair rewards
fixed: The PLAY button in the lobby is smaller and never runs into the side boxes, in every theme
Online hero XP only counts when BOTH players are logged in and the match is confirmed by both — playing against a guest gives no XP, crystals or rank
After accepting a room invite, the PLAY ONLINE menu no longer stays open on top of the room

releases.title: Tutorial steps work again
fixed: After the tutorial (and after pressing PLAY) the steps at the top work again: choose ONLINE or OFFLINE, then your hero, then an arena (offline) or who to play with (online), and the game starts
The quick ONLINE / OFFLINE question for new players no longer shows steps that don't do anything

releases.title: Daily moved to your player card
new: DAILY is now the 📋 button on your player card, right under the 🔔 bell (for logged-in players). It shines and shows a red number when rewards are waiting
The top menu is shorter and tidier

releases.title: One GAME MODE button
new: ONLINE and OFFLINE are now one GAME MODE button in the top menu: pick friends, host, join, random player or VS COMPUTER in one place
The button shows the mode you are playing (for example VS COMPUTER or RANDOM PLAYER)
More room in the top menu, so nothing sits under the round buttons any more

releases.title: The big lobby update
new: UPDATES window: see what changed in every new version (this window!)
A banner tells you when a new update is ready while you play: just press RELOAD
Things you haven't finished yet (tutorial, daily missions, new updates) now shine in the lobby
Tutorial: a welcome card for new players and a guided tour of the lobby; the 🎓 button next to ? starts it any time
Private messages between friends and a 🔔 bell for friend requests and new messages
Themes: Moon Temple and Fire Forge are free; Magic Night, Sakura Dojo, Frost Kingdom and the legendary Golden Dragon in the theme shop
New top menu that works like browser tabs: heroes, arenas, rank, daily and theme open beside the game
Rank and weekly leaderboard always on the lobby
fixed: You stay logged in when you refresh the page
Pressing READY in a room now starts the match
Open rooms, guests and random-player search show up on phones too
All rooms are public unless you set a password
Arena row scrolls sideways on phones again
